This story adds the task list view that shows the saved tasks, with a status indicator and a priority indicator on each row. The list shows loading, empty and error states, and it refreshes after any task change.","business_value":"Users can see all their saved tasks, their status and their priority in one view, which is the base for managing the list.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"I have two or more saved tasks","when":"I open the to-do management page","then":"the task list shows every one of my saved tasks"},{"given":"A task has the status Open and the priority High","when":"the task list is displayed","then":"that task's row shows a status indicator with the value Open and a priority indicator with the value High"},{"given":"The task list is waiting for the task data from the backend","when":"the page is displayed","then":"a loading state is shown in place of the task list until the data arrives"},{"given":"I have no saved tasks","when":"the task list loads successfully","then":"an empty state is shown and no task rows are displayed"},{"given":"The backend returns an error when the task list is requested","when":"the task list loads","then":"an error state is shown, no task rows are displayed, and the page does not show a successful state"},{"given":"The database is unavailable","when":"the backend receives a request for all tasks","then":"the backend returns an internal server error response and does not return any task data"},{"given":"I am viewing the task list","when":"a task is created, updated, deleted or has its status changed","then":"the task list refreshes automatically and shows the change without a manual page reload"}],"edge_cases":["The list has no paging or limit in the PRD, so the view is expected to show all tasks returned by the backend. The maximum number of tasks is not specified.","The PRD does not say how tasks are linked to a user. This story returns all saved tasks and does not filter by user. The way tasks are assigned to a user is an open question.","When the backend returns no tasks, the empty state is shown and the error state is not shown.","When the backend returns an error, the error state is shown and no stale task rows remain on the screen.","When the data arrives after a delay, the loading state is replaced by the list or the empty state, not shown next to them.","The status values are Open, In Progress and Completed, and the priority values are Low, Medium and High.
